description: Legacy development fields that the schema-1 pack vocabulary cannot express, in whole or in part, and the fields the development pack has come to carry. The parity comparison does not cover the residue. delivered is the part of the field the development pack carries, or null when it carries none of it. residue is what stays outside the pack, or null when the pack carries the whole field (since GP-10B-2 PR 2 or, for the governance fields, GP-25 PR 2). owner is the task that owns the residue next, or, for an entry with no residue, the task that delivered it. gp09Gap is the GP-09 vocabulary gap code that reports the field in a state that uses it. inDefaultState is true for a field observed in the default legacy state and false for a legacy field the default state does not use, listed so that its owner is on record.

owners.GP-10B-2: Development descriptive contract extension and prompts (Runtime task e890324a-ecd4-4fcc-b1f8-37fdbdaca319)

entries.subject: office_role
entries.delivered: The ordered responsibilities of each default role, as the `responsibilities` of the pack role of the same ID.
entries.reason: Authored responsibility statements of an office role. The legacy field; a pack role could not carry it before GP-10B-2 PR 1; carried since pack 0.3.0.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Runtime role name, such as software-architect. Missing from the GP-09 gap list and recorded here; the frozen GP-09 profile is not edited.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Definition version of the Runtime role, which also versions its guidance.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Capability order. The Runtime stores an ordered list and a pack role holds a set; membership is compared, order is not.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Tools the Runtime role may call. A pack role declares no tool or integration.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Model policy of the Runtime role.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Runtime limits and constraints: maxIterations, maxCostMicros and timeoutSeconds.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.delivered: The guidance text and its digest: the prompt `<role>-guidance`, referenced by the agent of the role, whose text is the bytes of `agents/<role>/system.md`. The guidance version is covered by the separate Runtime role `version` entry.
entries.reason: Role guidance, the system instructions shipped as system.md: its text, digest and version. The text and the digest are carried since pack 0.3.0; the guidance version is covered by the separate runtime_role.version entry (owner a45ddb12).

entries.subject: agent
entries.reason: Whether the Runtime agent is enabled. A pack agent is a declaration and creates no Runtime agent.

entries.subject: task_kind
entries.delivered: All five routes, each as a task type of the workflow of that ID: `taskType` for feature, bugfix, research and release, and `additionalTaskTypes` for maintenance -> delivery.
entries.reason: Routing of a task kind to a pipeline. The legacy field; a pack workflow named one task type before GP-10B-2 PR 1, so the second kind of a pipeline that routes two had no place in the pack; carried since pack 0.3.0 as additionalTaskTypes.

entries.subject: pipeline
entries.delivered: Every task kind of each pipeline, as the task types of its workflow, including both task kinds of the delivery pipeline.
entries.reason: One pipeline routes several task kinds. The legacy field; a pack workflow named one task type before GP-10B-2 PR 1; carried since pack 0.3.0.

entries.subject: pipeline
entries.delivered: The enforcement of each workflow: `enforcement: "enforced"` on the `delivery` policy and none, which is guidance, on the other workflows. Declared only; nothing is enforced by the Runtime.
entries.reason: Whether the pipeline is enforced or guidance. Carried since pack 0.4.0 by the typed policy of each workflow.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: The stage name, as the stage `title`.
entries.reason: Stage name. The legacy field; a pack workflow stage was an ID and a role before GP-10B-2 PR 1; carried since pack 0.3.0 as its title.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: The stage objective, as the stage `objective`.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: The ordered checks of the stage, as the stage `checks`.
entries.reason: Check semantics: the checks a stage must satisfy.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: `requiresApproval: true` on `delivery/review`, `bugfix/review` and `release/verification`, in the policy of each workflow. Declared only; nothing is enforced by the Runtime.
entries.reason: Approval semantics: whether completing the stage requires an approval. Carried since pack 0.4.0 by the typed policy of each workflow.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: The admitted `operations` of each stage: none, which is the absent field and equals the legacy empty and absent `capabilities`. Declared only; nothing is enforced by the Runtime.
entries.reason: Capabilities a stage requires. Carried since pack 0.4.0 as the admitted `operations` of a policy stage.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: The clause form `requiresIndependentApproval: true`. No default stage uses it, so no policy declares it. Nothing is enforced by the Runtime.
entries.reason: Approval semantics: whether the agent assigned to the stage is barred from deciding its approval. The default state does not use it. Carried since pack 0.4.0 as a clause form; no default exercises it.

entries.subject: stage
entries.delivered: The clause form `requiresDifferentAgentFrom`, a set of earlier stages. No default stage uses it, so no policy declares it. Nothing is enforced by the Runtime.
entries.reason: Separation constraint: earlier stages whose agent may not do this stage. The default state does not use it. Carried since pack 0.4.0 as a clause form; no default exercises it.
